_comment: CANONICAL definition of the live 'ai4ia-toolbox' Foundry toolbox. This is the source of truth a new subscription/tenant reproduces 1:1: run scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py --create against the target project to create this exact toolbox, then the foundryToolbox entry in infra/mcp-servers.json fronts it through APIM (its URL is computed by main.bicep per environment). Matches what is deployed in the slurmfactory project. To change the toolbox, edit here and re-run the script (creates a new version). See foundry/toolbox.manifest.example.json for the full set of supported tools, and docs/foundry-toolbox.md.
name: ai4ia-toolbox
description: AI4IA shared Foundry toolbox: grounding, code execution, tool search. Fronted through the official-MCP APIM.

tools.name: tool-search
tools.description: Tool search: lets the model pick from the toolbox's tools.
